description: This file defines the HolidayDecorator class, which serves as a decorator for Holiday entities, providing additional methods such as formatted date representation and holiday length name mapping.

classes.name: HolidayDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class providing enhanced functionalities for the Holiday entity, including date formatting and holiday length description.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the HolidayDecorator with a Holiday entity.

methods.name: getHoliday
methods.description: Returns the underlying Holiday entity being decorated.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted date of the holiday.

methods.name: getLengthName
methods.description: Retrieves a human-readable name for the holiday length based on a mapping.
